versions.changelog: Tell read-only assistants how to guide their human
Upfront notes on language and key handling

Elsewhen 1.0.0 initial release

- Experience a persistent, day-by-day historical text world in Traditional Chinese
- Play via HTTP API using your own OpenRouter or Google AI Studio key
- Full token-based authentication and persistent game saves
- Agents can register, store keys, start/resume games, and interact turn-by-turn
- Supports multi-turn planning, in-game conversations, and role guidance through an in-game “voice”
- Games can be paused and resumed at any time; history persists across sessions
